note: Subscription plans (docs/subscription-plans-2026-11), written 23-Nov-2026 against the code on branch feat/subscription-plans. Added to test-cases.xlsx / tests/qa/catalog by scripts/qa/plan_workbook.py add-json.

features.feature: Subscription plans: any shop offers any product on subscription (kind, slot, serving days, frequencies, subscriber price, terms, lead days); customers find plans near them and subscribe; the shop gets a notice and a 7-day prep sheet

scenarios.title: A shop offers a product on subscription and customers near it subscribe
scenarios.description: A tiffin kitchen (or dairy, paper agent, any shop) makes a plan from one of its products; customers find it on the shop page or the plans page, subscribe within its rules and are charged the plan price on delivery days; the shop is told and sees what to prepare.

cases.title: Plan management and subscribing need the right signed-in user
cases.steps:
1. As a guest, GET and POST /api/shops/<any shop>/subscription-plans
2. As a guest, PUT, PATCH and DELETE /api/shops/<any shop>/subscription-plans/<any plan>
3. As a guest, POST /api/subscription-plans/<any plan>/subscribe
cases.expected: Each answers 401 UNAUTHENTICATED before reading the request; nothing is created or changed.

cases.title: A guest opening the plans pages is sent to sign-in; an unknown plan is 404
cases.steps:
1. As a guest, open /subscriptions/plans and /subscribe/plan/<any id>
2. GET /api/subscription-plans/<unknown id>
cases.expected: Both pages send the guest to sign-in; the API answers 404 for an unknown plan. GET /api/subscription-plans answers 200 (an empty list when there is no location).

cases.title: The shop makes one of its products a subscription plan
cases.preconditions: Shop A with a listed product (it need not be marked subscribable or be on sale online).
cases.steps:
1. Seller Central > Product categories > Subscription plans
2. New subscription plan: choose the product, name it, kind Meals & tiffin, slot Lunch, window 12:30–2 pm, subscriber price 80, days Mon–Sat, Every delivery day + Days of the week
3. Create plan
cases.expected: The plan is listed "Taking subscribers", Meals & tiffin, Lunch (12:30–2 pm), Mon–Sat, ₹80 per piece (subscriber price), 0 subscribers, open-ended. Another shop's product, a duplicate name, no serving day, or no price on a product without an online price is refused with a reason.

cases.title: Customers near the shop find the plan and subscribe within its rules
cases.preconditions: TC-SUB-030 done; customer 1's address inside shop A's delivery area.
cases.steps:
1. My Subscriptions > Subscription plans (or shop A's page > Subscription plans)
2. Filter Meals & tiffin, Lunch
3. Subscribe on the plan: 1 piece, Every delivery day, start tomorrow, default address
4. Subscribe
cases.expected: The plan is listed with the shop, distance, price per piece, delivery days and length; a shop that does not deliver there is not listed. The form offers only the plan's frequencies and serving days; 'Every delivery day' reads 'Delivered: Mon–Sat.'; the 30-day estimate is price × deliveries. The subscription opens showing the plan name and slot; Sundays have no delivery in its calendar.

cases.title: Choices outside the plan are refused
cases.preconditions: A plan with lead days 2 and fixed terms 7 / 30, Mon–Sat, Every day + Days of the week.
cases.steps:
1. Start tomorrow
2. Choose Sunday
3. Choose days of the month
4. Omit the plan length, or ask for 10 days
5. Take a plan that is switched off, or from a shop that does not deliver to the address
cases.expected: 422 each, with the reason (earliest start date; only days this plan is delivered; cannot be taken on days of the month; choose a plan length: 7, 30 days; does not deliver to the chosen address); a switched-off plan is 404. A valid 7-day choice ends 6 days after the start.

cases.title: Plan subscriptions are charged the plan price, on delivery days only
cases.preconditions: A Mon–Sat plan at a subscriber price, on a listing not on sale online; a subscriber from Monday.
cases.steps:
1. Run the daily subscription job for Monday
2. Run it for Sunday
cases.expected: Monday: one SUBSCRIPTION order to the shop at the plan price, wallet charged that amount. Sunday: no order. Without a plan the same listing cannot be subscribed.

cases.title: The shop is told of the subscriber and sees what to prepare
cases.expected: Notice 'New subscriber' naming the customer, plan, quantity, days and slot, start date and area. Subscribers shows 'Next 7 days — what to prepare' with the plan's deliveries and quantity per day (none on days the plan is not delivered, a skipped day reduced) and the subscriber row with plan and slot. The plan card shows 1 subscriber.

cases.title: Turning a plan off or removing it keeps running subscribers
cases.preconditions: A plan with a running subscriber.
cases.steps:
1. Turn off
2. Try to change its product
3. Remove
cases.expected: Off: new subscriptions refused, the plan hidden from customers. Product change refused while it has subscribers. Removed: gone from the shop's list; the running subscriber's deliveries continue until they cancel.
